description_en: Creates a database account and grants permissions
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-account-and-authority --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp1p816075e210000 --account-name test --account-password 123456Aa --dml-authority all --ddl-authority true --allow-databases db1 --allow-dictionaries dt1 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccountAndAuthority

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.

Must be unique within the cluster.

Can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

Must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。
名称唯一。
由小写字母、数字或下划线组成。
以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾。
长度为2~64个字符
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the database account.

Must contain characters from at least three of the following types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

The supported special characters are `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`.

Must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
特殊字符为!@#$%^&*()_+-=
长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the database account.

Cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Must be 0 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的描述。
不能以http://或https://开头。
长度为0~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the DML permissions for the database account. Valid values:

all: read, write, and settings permissions.

readOnly,modify: read and settings permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否授予数据库账号DML权限，取值说明：

all：读写和设置权限。
readOnly,modify：读取和设置权限
parameters.name: dml_authority

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant DDL permissions to the database account. Valid values:

true: DDL operations are allowed.

false: DDL operations are denied
parameters.help_zh:
是否授予数据库账号DDL权限，取值说明：

true：允许DDL。
false：禁止DDL
parameters.name: ddl_authority

parameters.help_en: The databases to which the account has permissions. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要授权的数据库列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: allow_databases

parameters.help_en: All databases in the cluster. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 所有数据库列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: total_databases

parameters.help_en: The dictionaries to which the account has permissions. Separate multiple dictionary names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要授权的字典列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: allow_dictionaries

parameters.help_en: All dictionaries in the cluster. Separate multiple dictionary names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 所有字典列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: total_dictionaries
